description: Batch summarizer with number check — Summarize up to 10 separate texts in one call. Pass texts as a JSON array of strings or as texts separated by ||. Each text gets a short summary (max_words, default 40, up to 150) plus 1-4 key points, word counts and a compression ratio; commonThemes lists themes shared across texts. Every number in each summary and its key points is checked offline against that text's own source, and any number not found there is listed in unsupportedNumbers (numberCheck OK / REVIEW). Optional focus= steers what the summaries emphasize. Workers AI (Llama 3.3 70B). Price: $0.015 USDC (Base, via x402).

texts.description: e.g. The city council approved a $4.2 million budget for park repairs on Tuesday. Work begins in March.||Acme Corp reported revenue of $120 million, up 8% from last year, and raised its outlook.

name: ai_summarize_batch
